title: A workflow may not key its concurrency group on a bare ref — a queued run that never executed can otherwise be cancelled into a permanently dead required check, leaving the PR unmergeable with no code failure

The dispatch load-detail query must RESOLVE the primary driver name and unit number, not only carry their ids — a drawer that renders a covered load as "Unassigned" invites double-assignment, and the entity predicates on those joins must scope units by the owner/leased pair
